workflow_title: BIDS-conformant MRI dataset curation and fMRIPrep preprocessing pipeline
occupation_scope: Neuroimaging research scientist or MRI data analyst who turns raw scanner output into analysis-ready derivatives
workflow_summary: Convert raw scanner DICOM output from a research study into a BIDS-valid dataset and analysis-ready fMRIPrep derivatives that any downstream pipeline can consume; typical scenario is a lab building an audit-ready archive of a newly acquired or shared MRI dataset.
source_reference: BIDS Specification introduction https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/introduction.html (verified 200); Gorgolewski et al. 2016 BIDS Scientific Data 3:160044 DOI 10.1038/sdata.2016.44 (search-confirmed, fetch interstitial); Esteban et al. 2019 fMRIPrep Nature Methods 16:111-116 DOI 10.1038/s41592-018-0235-4 (search-confirmed, fetch interstitial); fMRIPrep documentation https://fmriprep.org/en/stable/ (verified 200); OpenNeuro documentation https://docs.openneuro.org/ (verified 200); HCP Young Adult Data Use Terms https://www.humanconnectome.org/study/hcp-young-adult/data-use-terms (verified 200)
expert_raw_materials: Raw DICOM scanner exports; scanner protocol parameter sheets; participant consent forms stating the data sharing tier; existing public BIDS datasets such as OpenNeuro or HCP as in-kind reference material
usage_permissions: Public datasets may be used only under their individual licenses; OpenNeuro datasets carry per-dataset licenses, HCP Young Adult Data Use Terms require online registration and restrict commercial use and re-identification attempts; hospital-internal or clinical imaging is not a default input and needs an institution-approved data-sharing agreement; BIDS is an open specification and fMRIPrep is Apache-2.0 open source
task_input: A study folder of DICOM files plus a dataset description file mapping subject IDs, sessions, and tasks; a target BIDS version; a containerized fMRIPrep invocation with chosen output spaces
professional_operations: 1. Inventory scanner output and sidecar metadata; 2. Convert DICOM to NIfTI with heudiconv or dcm2niix and organize files into the BIDS directory layout; 3. Run the official BIDS validator and fix errors until the dataset is valid; 4. Run fMRIPrep with declared output spaces and capture generated confounds; 5. Produce participant-level and group-level QC reporting covering motion, registration quality, and brain masks; 6. Publish derivatives with provenance to a versioned store or archive
expected_deliverable: A BIDS-valid raw dataset plus fMRIPrep derivatives, a group QC report with motion and registration summaries, and a provenance log linking derivatives to software and container versions
success_criteria: The official BIDS validator reports zero errors; fMRIPrep completes every requested subject run with nonzero functional masks; the QC report and derivative inventory cover every declared subject; the provenance log names all software versions
verification_approach: Re-run the official bids-validator CLI and assert an error-free log; parse the fMRIPrep HTML reports for per-subject failures; compare the derivative file inventory against the expected BIDS derivatives layout; assume container images match documented versions and input DICOMs are complete
platform_dependencies: Linux workstation or cluster with Docker or Singularity container runtime; network access for template downloads such as MNI152 and FreeSurfer fsaverage; roughly 8GB RAM per subject-session run; Node.js runtime for the BIDS validator
blocking_risks: Missing or mislabeled DICOM metadata halts conversion; FreeSurfer surface reconstruction components require registration and are not freely redistributable; proprietary scanner formats may need vendor converters with their own licensing; public datasets whose consent tier excludes the planned processing must be dropped
expert_capability: Neuroscientist or neuroimaging analyst who reads scanner protocol parameters, detects DICOM anonymization gaps, and interprets motion and registration QC; professional judgment selects the preprocessing options the pipeline then executes
cross_domain_overlap: Suspected adjacency with B1 med_diag_wf01 (BI-RADS mammography reading) and B1 med_diag_wf05 (Fleischner nodule management): both consume medical images but interpret disease in clinical studies, while this row standardizes research data without diagnostic claims; suspected adjacency with B1 life_cellimg_wf04 (REMBI archive deposition) as another structured data-archiving workflow on a different modality
granularity_check: One workflow because DICOM conversion, BIDS validation, and fMRIPrep preprocessing form a single pipeline with one artifact chain: each step's output is only meaningful as the next step's input and the deliverable is the completed archive
pending_confirmation: Confirm the lab's target BIDS version and whether surface outputs are required; confirm handling of disease-specific or non-standard acquisitions; the OpenNeuro default-license wording was not captured by the fetcher and must be checked per dataset before reuse
data_usage_authorization: Processing is permitted only for datasets whose license or data-use agreement covers that processing; hospital-internal images or identifiable scans require explicit institutional authorization and are excluded by default
privacy_considerations: De-identification must be re-verified after DICOM to NIfTI conversion because private fields like names and dates can persist in files or sidecars; T1-derived surface images can enable facial re-identification and must be defaced before sharing
research_ethics: The consent tier governs all sharing and processing; pipelines must never submit protected health information to external compute without an agreement
reproducibility_assessment: High: pinned BIDS version, container tags, and recorded parameters enable exact re-execution; fidelity still depends on complete raw metadata and on the original consent tier
primary_claim: The BIDS specification defines the community-agreed standard for organizing and describing neuroimaging data, and it is the contract that interoperable pipelines such as fMRIPrep consume and validate against.

workflow_title: COBIDAS-MEEG-compliant M/EEG study analysis and reporting workflow
occupation_scope: MEG or EEG researcher who plans, analyzes, and writes up an electrophysiology study so reviewers can trace every reporting component
workflow_summary: Plan, execute, and report an MEG or EEG study by walking the COBIDAS MEEG community checklist from experimental design through data sharing, so the resulting manuscript satisfies the reporting standard the field's best-practice committee published; typical scenario is a study whose data will also be deposited on OpenNeuro.
source_reference: COBIDAS MEEG white paper of the OHBM COBIDAS MEEG Committee https://cobidasmeeg.wordpress.com/ (verified 200); Pernet et al. 2020 COBIDAS MEEG summary Nature Neuroscience DOI 10.1038/s41593-020-00709-0 (verified 200 cookie-interstitial); MNE-Python documentation https://mne.tools/stable/index.html (verified 200); COBIDAS MRI precedent Nichols et al. 2017 Nature Neuroscience 20:299-303 DOI 10.1038/nn.4500 (search-confirmed, not fetched)
expert_raw_materials: Raw MEG or EEG recordings organized in BIDS-MEG or BIDS-iEEG layout; digitized sensor layouts; the event code schema; annotated artifact segments; a partially filled COBIDAS MEEG checklist as the working document
usage_permissions: Public datasets may be used under their individual licenses, for example OpenNeuro per-dataset licenses and HCP Data Use Terms which restrict redistribution and re-identification; hospital EEG or MEG requires an institutional ethics approval and data agreement; MNE-Python is BSD-3 licensed and the COBIDAS MEEG text is openly hosted with committee attribution requested
task_input: One BIDS-organized M/EEG dataset; a preregistration or written analysis plan; the six-section COBIDAS MEEG checklist as the guiding working document
professional_operations: 1. Complete the COBIDAS MEEG experimental-design section including a predetermined power justification; 2. Document every acquisition parameter in the data-acquisition section; 3. Preprocess the data with filtering, ICA or SSP artifact removal, and bad-channel interpolation, recording each choice in the preprocessing section; 4. Run sensor-space or source-space statistical modeling with a preselected multiple-comparison correction in the modeling section; 5. Report results with effect sizes and uncertainty in the results section; 6. Write the data-sharing statement and deposition plan in the sharing section
expected_deliverable: A completed six-section COBIDAS MEEG checklist, a versioned MNE-Python script set, QC figures for preprocessing and modeling choices, and a data-sharing statement ready for journal submission
success_criteria: Every checklist row carries an answer or an explicit not-applicable note; the final script reproduces every reported statistic; the multiple-comparison correction strategy is declared before hypothesis testing; the sharing statement matches the consent tier
verification_approach: Lint the checklist for unanswered mandatory fields; re-run the analysis script on the derivative data and compare reported statistics within rounding; cross-check event and trial counts against the raw trigger log; assume the checklist interpretation in this workflow matches the white paper text
platform_dependencies: Linux workstation with Python 3 and MNE-Python; MATLAB license if FieldTrip is used; several GB of RAM for source-space operations; network access when MNE sample or tutorial data is needed
blocking_risks: Proprietary MEG vendor files may need vendor-specific importers that are unavailable offline; clinical data attached to patient identity cannot be analyzed as research without ethics approval; if the preregistration is missing or post-hoc, the power and analysis sections lose their evidentiary weight
expert_capability: M/EEG researcher who understands how filtering and artifact rejection change the statistics and can interpret source-localization output; professional judgment accepts or overrides each checklist entry
cross_domain_overlap: Suspected adjacency with B1 med_trials_wf05 (clinical trial registration) because both capture predeclared analysis plans, but this row governs electrophysiology reporting while that row governs interventional trial registration; suspected adjacency with any B1 biosignal-processing row in the medical clusters, which I can flag only generically because those candidate names were not visible to this fragment
granularity_check: One workflow because the COBIDAS MEEG standard itself integrates design, acquisition, preprocessing, modeling, results, and sharing into one checklist-governed professional cycle with a single paper-level deliverable
pending_confirmation: Confirm whether the target journal requires the full checklist as a submission appendix or a short summary statement; confirm the BIDS derivative level the lab publishes; several checklist items require professional interpretation and cannot be auto-filled by an agent alone
data_usage_authorization: Public dataset licenses control use and redistribution; hospital M/EEG data require ethics-board approval and a data-transfer agreement before any agent or analyst processes them
privacy_considerations: Head geometry and scalp-surface data can be identifying; share defaced data and only the derivatives the consent allows; never publish identifiable raw surfaces or clinical identifiers; verify anonymization across binary sidecars as well as text headers
research_ethics: Only data from documented informed consent may be used; preregistration of the power decision and correction strategy prevents post-hoc analytic choices; participants' withdrawal rights follow the consent tier documented in the sharing section
reproducibility_assessment: High when the software environment is version-pinned and artifact-rejection choices are logged; intermediate when manual ICA component selection is not recorded
primary_claim: The COBIDAS MEEG community standard defines checklist-based best practice spanning experimental design, acquisition, preprocessing, statistical modeling, results reporting, and data sharing for M/EEG studies.

workflow_title: Hierarchical Bayesian fitting of choice and response-time models under the ten-rules workflow
occupation_scope: Computational neuroscientist or cognitive modeler who fits reinforcement-learning or drift-diffusion models to behavioral experiment data
workflow_summary: Fit and validate generative cognitive models such as reinforcement learning or drift diffusion against behavioral choice and reaction-time data following Wilson and Collins' ten rules, and deliver model-comparison evidence that survives reviewer scrutiny; typical scenario is the model-based analysis of a decision experiment.
source_reference: Wilson and Collins 2019 Ten simple rules for the computational modeling of behavioral data eLife 8:e49547 DOI 10.7554/eLife.49547 https://elifesciences.org/articles/49547 (verified 200); Wiecki et al. 2013 HDDM Frontiers in Neuroinformatics 7:14 DOI 10.3389/fninf.2013.00014 (verified 200 via redirect) https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/neuroinformatics/articles/10.3389/fninf.2013.00014/full; HDDM documentation https://hddm.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ (verified 200)
expert_raw_materials: Trial-level behavioral data tables with choices, reaction times, and condition labels; the lab's model specification and prior preferences; earlier fitted model outputs as reference chains
usage_permissions: Input data must be the researcher's own consented experiment data or licensed reuse data; open tools: HDDM is LGPL and PyMC-family and Stan are permissively licensed; the eLife guidance paper is open access
task_input: A cleaned trial-level data table; a candidate model list with free-parameter definitions; prior distributions per parameter; a compute budget and a fixed random-seed policy
professional_operations: 1. Specify candidate models and priors following rules 1 to 3; 2. Fit models with hierarchical Bayesian samplers such as HDDM or PyMC and check convergence diagnostics following rules 4 to 6; 3. Run posterior predictive checking and parameter recovery on synthetic data following rules 7 and 8; 4. Compute model comparison with a preselected criterion following rule 9; 5. Report all fits, warnings, and model failures honestly following rule 10
expected_deliverable: A computational modeling report with convergence diagnostics, parameter-recovery results, posterior-predictive plots, a model-comparison table, and versioned fit scripts
success_criteria: R-hat values below 1.05 for every reported parameter; parameter recovery recovers generating values inside credible intervals on synthetic data; posterior predictive coverage falls within the agreed tolerance; no model is reported without a comparison baseline
verification_approach: Re-fit the accepted model with a different random seed and compare posteriors; run parameter recovery on synthetic data generated from the fitted model; parse sampler logs for divergences; assume the input data table is ground truth and the model parameters are identifiable
platform_dependencies: Linux workstation or cluster with Python 3, PyMC or Stan or HDDM, and optional fast linear-algebra libraries; minutes to hours of CPU per fit depending on trial count and parameter dimensionality
blocking_risks: Unidentifiable or degenerate model parameters halt or invalidate fitting; slow samplers may need NUTS tuning expertise that exceeds routine agent capability; the license of the original experiment data may forbid the reanalysis
expert_capability: Cognitive computational modeler who judges model identifiability, prior specification, and convergence diagnostics; the agent runs the pipeline but the supervising modeler must approve the model space
cross_domain_overlap: Sibling of psy_exp_wf02 in this fragment: both analyze behavioral data, but this row fits generative models and compares them while psy_exp_wf02 performs hypothesis testing under a preregistered design; suspected adjacency with B1 med_pubhealth_wf04 weighted-survey statistical analysis as another quantitative analysis workflow with an overlapping statistical toolchain
granularity_check: One workflow because the ten rules define a single modeling-reporting cycle: specification, fitting, validation, and reporting are components of one professional deliverable and not severable analyses
pending_confirmation: E3 gap: the ten rules guide design but no professional society publishes a normative checklist for model-fitting SOPs, so the lab's acceptance thresholds for convergence and comparison metrics must be confirmed; confirm the preferred sampler, HDDM versus PyMC, with the supervising modeler
data_usage_authorization: Reanalysis of behavioral data needs the original study's consent and data-sharing terms; derived statistics may be published only where the data license allows them
privacy_considerations: Dense trial-level data can fingerprint participants, especially with many trials per person; report group distributions and avoid publishing full trialwise streams that enable re-identification
research_ethics: Report every attempted model and failed fit to prevent selective reporting of favorable specifications; parameter recovery serves as the ethical self-check of statistical claims
reproducibility_assessment: High: fixed seeds, version-pinned toolchain, and published scripts enable re-execution, provided priors and sampler tuning choices are logged completely
primary_claim: Wilson and Collins' ten simple rules define a complete citable good-practice cycle for specifying, fitting, validating, and honestly reporting computational models of behavioral data.

workflow_title: Self-hosted online experiment deployment on JATOS for institution-compliant data collection
occupation_scope: Experimental psychologist or lab manager who builds, hosts, and monitors a web-based behavioral study on institutional infrastructure
workflow_summary: Build a browser-based behavioral experiment, deploy it on a self-hosted JATOS server with a linked database, recruit and deduplicate participants, and export complete result files with consent metadata; typical scenario is a multi-day online study that an ethics board requires to remain on institutional servers.
source_reference: Lange, Kuehn, and Filevich 2015 JATOS paper PLoS ONE 10(6):e0130834 DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0130834 https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0130834 (verified 200, CC BY 4.0); JATOS documentation https://www.jatos.org/ (verified 200); PsychoPy documentation https://psychopy.org/ (verified 200); Peirce et al. 2019 PsychoPy2 Behavior Research Methods 51:195-203 DOI 10.3758/s13428-018-01193-y (search-confirmed, fetch interstitial)
expert_raw_materials: Experiment protocol and ethics-approved consent text; stimulus and trial-list files; pilot response logs; recruitment and payment policies from the chosen panel like Prolific or Mechanical Turk
usage_permissions: JATOS and jsPsych are open source under Apache-style licenses and may be self-hosted; participant data resides on the researcher's own server so institutional IT policy applies; any commercial instrument embedded in a task keeps its own license and may not be redistributed
task_input: A study definition with consent page, instruction pages, trial sequence, and debrief; a stimulus file list; a target participant quota; validated server credentials for the institution-approved host
professional_operations: 1. Author task pages in jsPsych or PsychoJS and upload study assets to the server; 2. Configure worker management and study properties such as single-run enforcement and participant deduplication; 3. Pilot the study internally and check timing and logging fidelity; 4. Collect data on the researcher's domain with informed consent recorded per participant; 5. Export result strings and join them with worker metadata for completeness checks; 6. Archive results and deactivate the study per the data-retention plan
expected_deliverable: A running study on the lab's own server, a complete export of result data with per-worker study codes, and an integrity report covering completes, duplicates, and timing outliers
success_criteria: All defined pages load from the server and participant counts match the recruitment platform log; no worker completes more attempts than the study allows; every exported record carries a consent timestamp
verification_approach: Run a scripted fake participant through the study and diff the export against expected values; compare recruitment-platform completion counts to server exports; assert a consent timestamp on every record; assume the server configuration matches the protocol approved for this lab
platform_dependencies: Self-hosted Linux server or workstation with a Java runtime, H2 or MySQL or MariaDB as the database, a stable domain or campus network path, and a modern browser for the administration GUI; optional Prolific or Mechanical Turk accounts for recruitment
blocking_risks: Institutional firewall or data-classification rules may forbid internet-facing servers; timing-sensitive tasks degrade on participants' variable devices and browsers; recruitment platform terms may restrict the redirect-based completion tracking
expert_capability: Experimental psychologist who verifies the consent flow, counterbalancing scheme, and timing validity; server administration can be delegated to IT but protocol approval is professional judgment
cross_domain_overlap: No matching B1 or S1-02A row is visible to this fragment: B1 med_pubhealth_wf04 analyzes weighted survey responses while this row builds the collection instrument, so they touch the same participant pipeline at different stages; suspected future adjacency with any crowd-data collection workflow
granularity_check: One workflow because authoring, deployment, collection, and export form one instrument lifecycle: no single intermediate step is a meaningful deliverable alone
pending_confirmation: E3 gap: no society standard mandates JATOS specifically, so confirm the lab's server environment, IRB data-classification requirements, and GDPR records for worker identifiers before deployment
data_usage_authorization: Only participants who consented through the online form may enter analysis; recruiter platform terms govern worker payment records; moving the study to a third-party host requires fresh consent approval
privacy_considerations: JATOS is designed to store no IP addresses or browser fingerprints, only worker identifiers; exported Prolific worker IDs are still personal data under GDPR and must be treated accordingly
research_ethics: Debriefing, withdrawal, and the right to deletion must be executable from within the task flow and verified, not assumed; ethics approval precedes any live participant contact
reproducibility_assessment: High: study assets and properties can be versioned and redeployed; timing fidelity depends on participant hardware, so calibration trials are part of the design
primary_claim: JATOS provides an out-of-the-box open-source server, database, and administration GUI for researcher-hosted online experiments, which keeps participant data on the researcher's own infrastructure.

workflow_title: Power-justified experimental design and behavioral data analysis in R
occupation_scope: Experimental or quantitative psychologist who determines the sample size and performs the primary analysis of an experiment
workflow_summary: Determine an a-priori justified sample size from published reference tables, preregister the design, and run the complete frequentist or Bayesian analysis with multiple-comparison control in R; typical scenario is the analysis plan of a lab experiment written before data collection begins.
source_reference: Brysbaert 2019 Journal of Cognition 2(1):16 DOI 10.5334/joc.72 (CC BY 4.0, verified 200) https://journalofcognition.org/articles/10.5334/joc.72; APA Journal Article Reporting Standards quantitative page https://apa.org/pubs/journals/resources/quantitative-article-standards (verified 200); R Project https://www.r-project.org/ (verified 200); OSF Registrations user guide https://help.osf.io/article/330-welcome-to-registrations (verified 200 after redirect)
expert_raw_materials: Pilot or literature effect-size estimates; the design specification with factors and levels; the experiment data frames; a preregistration template; prior defaults when a Bayesian analysis is planned
usage_permissions: R and its packages are open source under GPL-family licenses; OSF preregistration is free for research use; experiment data must come from consented participants; the Brysbaert tutorial is CC BY so its tables may be reused with attribution
task_input: A design specification and chosen smallest effect size of interest; the preregistration text; a cleaned long or wide data frame with anonymized participant identifiers
professional_operations: 1. Justify an effect size from literature or the d=.4 convention and take the sample size from the tutorial's reference tables or recompute in R; 2. Write and time-stamp the preregistration before data collection; 3. Execute the analysis script with planned control for multiple comparisons; 4. Produce descriptive, inferential, and effect-size statistics in APA style; 5. Compare the analysis against the preregistration and log every deviation; 6. Package anonymized data and scripts for journal sharing
expected_deliverable: A preregistration-linked analysis report with power justification, a full statistics table with effect sizes, a deviation log, and reproducible R scripts
success_criteria: The reported sample size meets or exceeds the preregistered target; every confirmatory test has a matching preregistered item; the multiple-comparison correction is declared in advance and applied consistently
verification_approach: Recompute the power numbers from the reference tables and diff against the report; rerun the R scripts in a clean session and compare numeric outputs; check that registry and preregistration timestamps precede data collection; assume the tables were transcribed correctly
platform_dependencies: Linux workstation with R and packages such as psych, tidyverse, TOSTER, and BayesFactor; an OSF account via the web; G*Power is optional and only conditionally usable through Wine, which this workflow avoids
blocking_risks: Data collected before preregistration invalidates the workflow's central claim; missing effect-size evidence forces a conventions-based assumption that must be labeled as such; broken participant identifiers prevent within-subject joins
expert_capability: Quantitative psychologist who argues the effect-size rationale and designates the confirmatory analysis family; statistical literacy, not tooling, is the bottleneck
cross_domain_overlap: Sibling of psy_comp_wf03 in this fragment: model fitting versus hypothesis testing on the same behavioral data; suspected adjacency with B1 med_pubhealth_wf04 weighted survey analysis because both are survey-design-aware statistical analyses in R, differing in sampling weighting and population
granularity_check: One workflow because power justification, preregistration, and analysis form one evidence chain: the analysis is only gradeable against the preregistered plan it begins from
pending_confirmation: E3 gap: the combined workflow is assembled from a tutorial and a reporting standard, so confirm which reporting checklist the institution adopts and whether the lab standardizes on frequentist p less than .05 or Bayesian Bayes factors from the tutorial's tables
data_usage_authorization: Publishing raw data requires consent language that permits open data; otherwise share only summary statistics; the analysis scripts themselves carry no restriction
privacy_considerations: Anonymize participant identifiers before shared analysis files; small demographic combinations can re-identify individuals and may require suppression
research_ethics: Preregistration must precede data collection to prevent p-hacking; non-significant results must be reported in full detail including effect sizes and intervals
reproducibility_assessment: High: pinned package versions and the deviation log enable near-identical reruns; lower when interactive outlier decisions are not scripted
primary_claim: Brysbaert's tutorial provides reference tables and a justification standard for planning sample sizes of the common psychology designs at 80 percent power for effects of d=.4.

workflow_title: Standards-governed psychological test development and validation
occupation_scope: Psychometrician, test developer, or assessment psychologist who builds or validates a scale under the AERA, APA, and NCME Standards
workflow_summary: Develop or validate a psychological scale or test covering construct definition, item authoring, reliability and validity evidence, norms, and fairness review under the Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing; typical scenarios are building a new survey instrument or validating a translated existing scale.
source_reference: Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing official page, AERA/APA/NCME 2014 edition https://www.apa.org/science/programs/testing/standards (verified 200, page body not text-extracted by fetcher); APA Journal Article Reporting Standards quantitative page https://apa.org/pubs/journals/resources/quantitative-article-standards (verified 200); R Project https://www.r-project.org/ (verified 200)
expert_raw_materials: Construct definition documents; item pools with response scales; pilot response data matrices; cognitive interview transcripts; licensed reference norms where applicable; validation sample data with demographic codes
usage_permissions: The Standards book must be purchased or accessed through an institutional license and is not freely redistributable; commercial instruments like the MMPI and WAIS require purchase and publisher authorization for administration, scoring, and norm access, and their items may not be reproduced; the researcher's own items belong to the researcher or institution under the authorship policy
task_input: An item pool and response-scale definitions; a validation data matrix; the construct definition; a target population description
professional_operations: 1. Define the construct and an evidence framework mapped to the Standards chapters; 2. Author or translate items under content-validity review; 3. expected_deliverable: A validation report in technical-manual form with item statistics, reliability indices, factor structure, validity evidence, fairness analysis, and scoring instructions
success_criteria: Every validity-evidence category claimed has a corresponding quantitative result; reliability indices meet the declared standard; the fairness analysis flags group disparities and documents remediation
verification_approach: Re-run the psychometric analyses from the shared data and reproduce the coefficients; cross-check each claimed evidence section against the Standards chapter checklist; assume response data are licensed for this analysis and the construct framework is expert-approved
platform_dependencies: Linux workstation with R packages psych, lavaan, semTools, and mirt; office software for the technical manual; the purchased Standards book as the authoritative reference
blocking_risks: Commercial scale items needed for translation or equivalence studies require publisher licensing, without which the study hard-stops; small validation samples destabilize factor solutions; restricted norms cannot be approximated from public data
expert_capability: Psychometrician who maps each evidence type to the Standards and interprets item-level and factor statistics; the agent executes analyses but the validity claims require professional sign-off
cross_domain_overlap: Suspected adjacency with psy_exp_wf02 in this fragment: both run psychometric analysis in R, but this row is the development and validation cycle governed by the Standards while psy_exp_wf02 is experiment analysis planning; suspected adjacency with B1 med_pubhealth_wf04 survey analysis in their shared measurement-modeling machinery
granularity_check: One workflow because construct definition, item analysis, validity evidence, and fairness review form the single Standards-governed validation cycle: intermediate statistics are not meaningful deliverables alone
pending_confirmation: E1 stands on the published Standards; the APA page body could not be text-extracted by the fetcher, so chapter-level checklist items must be confirmed against the purchased book; confirm whether the instrument makes clinical claims that require device-level regulatory review
data_usage_authorization: Using the MMPI, WAIS, or other commercial instruments requires purchase, licensed scoring, and publisher authorization; unlicensed use or item reproduction is prohibited; the researcher's own instrument data follow the participant consent terms
privacy_considerations: Item-level response matrices are sensitive psychological data when re-identifiable; small demographic cells may require suppression of item-level detail
research_ethics: Validity claims must not overstate what each evidence type supports; the Standards fairness chapter governs ethical score use for the tested populations
reproducibility_assessment: High for the statistical core when data, code, and package versions are archived; item content may be confidential and reproduced only under publisher terms
primary_claim: The APA page is the official public reference point for the Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing, jointly maintained by AERA, APA, and NCME, which define the evidence categories for test development and use.
engineering_pending: YES: open-source substitute covers part of the proprietary tool; functional equivalence NOT verified

workflow_title: PRISMA-2020-compliant systematic review and meta-analysis in psychology
occupation_scope: Research-synthesis methodologist or psychology review researcher who conducts and reports reproducible evidence syntheses
workflow_summary: Conduct a transparent, reproducible systematic review and quantitative synthesis of psychological effect or intervention studies following PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane methodology; typical scenario is aggregating experiments or trials for a registered review of a treatment or effect question.
source_reference: PRISMA 2020 statement, checklist, and flow diagram https://www.prisma-statement.org/ (verified 200); Page et al. 2021 BMJ 372:n71 DOI 10.1136/bmj.n71 (search-confirmed, fetch 403 bot-wall, citation-level); Cochrane Handbook current edition online https://www.cochrane.org/authors/handbooks-and-manuals/handbook/current (verified 200 via redirect); R Project https://www.r-project.org/ (verified 200)
expert_raw_materials: The corpus of included study PDFs with extracted data tables; the protocol document; risk-of-bias assessment forms; effect-size inputs obtained from primary authors; search-strategy logs exported from literature databases
usage_permissions: PRISMA materials are openly available with citation; Cochrane Handbook content is publicly readable under Cochrane's terms for educational reference; included primary papers remain under publisher copyright, so wholesale reproduction is restricted while extracted data summaries are fine
task_input: A protocol with a research question and inclusion-exclusion criteria; database export files in their platform formats; a predefined effect-size extraction spreadsheet template
professional_operations: 1. Register the protocol and freeze the search strategy; 2. Run the literature searches and screen records with two independent screeners whose decisions are logged; 3. workflow_title: 按巴塞尔 FRTB 标准的交易台损益归因（P&L Attribution/PLA）检验与内部模型资本审批工作流
occupation_scope: 银行市场风险部的量化风险分析师 / 交易台风险经理
workflow_summary: 依 BCBS 457《市场风险最低资本要求》（FRTB）对交易台执行损益归因检验：以风险理论损益（RTPL）对比假设损益（HPL），按 Spearman 相关性不低于 0.8 及双侧 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 95% 分布检验划分绿/黄/红区并逐月监测，12 个月内累计红区达到标准的交易台退出内部模型法（按标准法计资本）。规则文本公开成文，Agent 在授权损益数据上可端到端复现统计检验、分区判定与监测台账逻辑
source_reference: BCBS 457 Minimum capital requirements for market risk（BIS，2019-01，d457.htm 已验证 200）；EBA RTS 与各国实施细则为延伸参考（名称引用，未逐页验证）
expert_raw_materials: 交易台日度假设损益与风险理论损益序列（脱敏或银行书面授权导出）；敞口与风险因子清单；行内回溯检验与 PLA 策略说明；FRTB 标准文本
usage_permissions: BCBS 457 为 BIS 公开文本可自由使用；行内损益序列属银行机密数据，须书面授权且仅限内部合规用途；构建 RTPL 所需风险因子行情按市场数据供应商许可条款使用，不得再分发；实时/延迟行情须从授权分发源取得，禁止自行抓取
task_input: 交易台授权 HPL/RTPL 日度序列（覆盖至少一个监测期）、适用的 FRTB 版本条款、阈值参数（Spearman 0.8、KS 双侧 95%、红区计数规则）
professional_operations: 1）按 FRTB 定义核对 HPL 与 RTPL 口径（估值调整、当日新交易与过期交易处理）；2）计算月度 Spearman 相关系数（阈 0.8）并执行 KS 双侧 95% 分布检验；3）按绿/黄/红区间标准逐月判定；4）跨 12 个月滚动统计红区频次并评估退出内部模型法后果；5）产出检验台账、结论与处置建议
expected_deliverable: 交易台 P&L 归因检验报告：指标计算明细、绿黄红分区判定、12 个月红区滚动统计、内部模型资本可用性结论与处置建议
success_criteria: Spearman 与 KS 计算值经双实现比对一致；分区判定与 BCBS 457 条款映射表逐条可溯源且合成数据边界用例全部通过；12 个月滚动监测程序可重复复现相同判定序列
verification_approach: 构造合成 P&L（正态/重尾/相关度可控）覆盖阈值边界用例并双实现交叉比对；对标准文本条款建映射表逐条勾稽；用公开论文数值示例复算验证
platform_dependencies: Linux Python3 + pandas/scipy；行内损益与头寸系统的数据馈送需银行侧权限；所用市场数据须为许可分发源且不得再分发；生产环境风险系统为专有软件，Agent 以开源统计实现完成检验计算层
blocking_risks: 真实交易台损益与头寸为高敏数据默认不可得，须银行授权；FRTB 各地区实施（EU CRR3、US final rule）与标准文本存在细节差异；若依赖的行情许可缺失则无法重构 RTPL
expert_capability: 熟悉 FRTB 内部模型法与前台损益口径的市场风险量化专家，能核对估值调整与检验边界情形
cross_domain_overlap: 与 actuarial_risk（6.2）同属风险量化的统计检证，差异在对象：本行针对交易账簿头寸的资本模型日损益检验，精算针对保险负债与生命周期的风险度量；仅有统计检验工具层面重叠，判定边界不同

workflow_title: 基于 Deflated Sharpe Ratio 的策略回测过拟合校正与绩效诚实披露工作流
occupation_scope: 量化研究员 / 量化策略组合经理
workflow_summary: 对量化策略历史回测执行 deflated Sharpe ratio 校正：登记策略发现过程的全部试验（试验次数 N、参数网格），以收益非正态性（偏度/峰度）修正的置信区间形式计算期望最大 Sharpe 与 DSR，甄别真实技能与过拟合噪声；并强制划分样本内/样本外、报告多重检验信息，按 SEC 206(4)-1 营销规则精神输出不误导的绩效披露口径。方法论文公开成文，Agent 在自有回测记录上可复现全部统计程序
source_reference: Bailey & López de Prado, The Deflated Sharpe Ratio: Correcting for Selection Bias, Backtest Overfitting and Non-Normality（Journal of Portfolio Management, 2014；作者主页 PDF 已验证 200）；配套方法 The Probability of Backtest Overfitting（2017，名称引用）
expert_raw_materials: 候选策略回测收益序列（含全部已试参数组合的试验记录与次数 N）；基准收益率序列；研究日志（失败策略与参数遍历不得删减）；经许可的历史行情源
usage_permissions: 论文公开免费；历史行情按供应商许可条款取得（回测内部用途许可普遍可得，再分发受限制）；官方基准报价的再分发边界按指数提供商许可执行，不得将原始行情随报告对外发布
task_input: 回测得到的 Sharpe 序列或候选策略收益、试验次数 N、收益偏度峰度估计、显著性目标（默认 95%）、样本内外划分规则
professional_operations: 1）登记策略发现全程试验盘（明确 N 与多重检验结构）；2）估计 SR 分布的偏度与峰度并构建非正态推断（PSR）；3）依论文封闭解计算 N 次试验下的期望最大 SR_0；4）计算 Deflated Sharpe Ratio 并按概率判定策略是否真实优于基准；5）执行样本内外划分与 walk-forward 复核；6）撰写含过拟合警示与披露口径的评估报告
expected_deliverable: 策略评估报告：各策略 DSR/PSR 值、试验次数与多重检验清单、样本内/样本外对比、含回测局限声明的绩效披露口径
success_criteria: 全部候选策略 DSR 按论文公式复算与原文数值示例一致；样本外表现与校正后预期一致；报告中包含重复使用同一数据源的过拟合风险披露且未挑选试验记录；披露口径避免误导性样本内业绩展示
verification_approach: 以论文数值示例与独立 Python 实现交叉复算；注入合成噪声与真实 alpha 的策略集做甄别力测试；单元测试覆盖偏度/峰度、N 与样本量边界
platform_dependencies: Linux Python3 + numpy/scipy/arch；历史行情须来自许可数据源（未经许可的公共接口抓取不可用）；统计量均可开源实现，无专有系统依赖
blocking_risks: 试验次数 N 的完整性依赖研究员纪要，低报 N 会虚增校正功效；无许可行情则回测本身不成立；样本内多次优化后的披露若缺 N 会导致评估失真
expert_capability: 具有策略研究与统计推断经验的量化研究员，能完整登记试验盘并解释 DSR/PSR 与过拟合概率结果
cross_domain_overlap: 与 economics（13.1）计量共享多重检验与样本外稳健性工具，差异在对象与决策：本行评估交易策略在大量试错下是否具备真实超额收益（常见务过拟合），计量学检验经济变量关系的因果推断假设
granularity_check: 一次策略立项评审（输入试验记录与收益序列、产出评估与披露口径）为策略晋升/否决的最小闭环，非多条独立工作流拼装

professional_operations: ①读 Data Dictionary，把委托人规格映射为 PUMS 变量与值编码；②以基础权重（PWGTP/WGTP）加全样本计算点估计 X（比例/均值/中位数；Census 中位数用线性插值定义）；③用 80 个复制权重逐个重算同一统计量得 Xr，按 SDR 公式由 Σ(Xr−X)² 构建标准误（官方文档原文表述；公式原图未文本化，实现时按文字描述）；④或走 GVF 路线：按特征类型从 Design Factors CSV 查设计因子并套用广义标准误公式，比率与中位数走文档规定的专项处理（如中位数上下限法）；⑤MOE=1.645×SE(X)，90% CI 按 LB/UB=X±1.645×SE(X)；⑥生成带 SE/MOE/CI、方法与年份注脚的统计表；⑦与 Census 已发布 ACS 表做量级核对，记录口径差异（PUMS 附加子抽样误差为官方说明的差异来源）；⑧签发技术备忘录说明加权与误差方法选择、SDR 得零 SE 情形的处置（文档提示中位数可改用 GVF 法）。
expected_deliverable: 交付带误差元数据的统计表（CSV/XLSX：每格=点估计+SE+90% MOE+CI+使用方法 SDR/GVF）与技术备忘录（变量映射、SDR/GVF 实现、与官方表核对表及口径差异说明）
success_criteria: ①每个交付统计量均有 SE/MOE/CI 且 MOE=1.645×SE 可被第三方复算；②80 个复制权重变量齐备（逐一重算后点估计不变）；③SDR 与 GVF 两法结果偏差符合文档所述方向（文档称 SDR 通常更准确）；④与 Census 发布 ACS 表的同口径子集核对时量级一致，差异归因并写入备忘录。
verification_approach: Linux 上用 Python（pandas/polars，sas7bdat 用 pyreadstat）独立复算：①自写 SDR 函数并与手算小样例对照；②断言测试：80 个复制权重齐全、全样本加权和≈官方记录数、SE≥0、CI 对称公式成立；③与官方 ACS 表交叉核对。假设：复制权重由 Census 以逐次差分复制法生成且其方差结构覆盖 PUMS 子抽样的附加误差；90% 对应 z=1.645 为官方设定；所用统计量（比例/均值/中位数）分别适用文档给定的公式路线。
platform_dependencies: Linux + Python3（pandas≥1.5 或 polars；sas7bdat 需 pyreadstat 或 R haven）；CSV 为原生格式，无专有许可依赖；person 级 CSV 数 GB、SDR 复算为 80 次全量重算，需足够内存/磁盘或分块；网络仅需 census.gov 下载。无 GPU/云平台需求。
blocking_risks: ①大文件内存/磁盘紧张；②中位数等非线性统计量的 GVF 专项流程易错；③设计因子 2024 起停更，沿用 GVF 需在报告中明示；④将 PUMS 估计直接等同已发布 ACS 表会犯口径错误（官方文档明示二者差异）。
expert_capability: 中高级调查统计师/实证经济学家：熟悉抽样方差理论（复制法、设计效应）、ACS PUMS 结构与复制权重机制、能读 Data Dictionary 并用开源工具实现、理解发布口径差异的官方统计素养。
cross_domain_overlap: 输入为普查公开微数据、操作为调查方差估计与误差发布、产物为官方统计口径的社会经济估计表。与 6.2 精算（保险赔付分布/定价）、6.3 企业内部决策分析、6.7 金融市场交易在输入/操作/产物三层均不同；与 B1 医学因果候选（治疗效应异质性/反事实学习）无数据与方法重叠。

workflow_title: 政策影响评估的倍差法（DID）设计、识别与估计工作流
occupation_scope: 国际组织/政府研究机构的政策影响评估专家、发展经济学家、政策分析师，对新政策或项目进行事后效果评估并向决策者沟通结论
workflow_summary: 面向扶貧、教育、健康、就業等政策项目，执行『变革理论与基線→准实验策略选择→DID 模型指定→识别假设逐条检验（平行趋势等）→估计与聚类推断→安慰剂/稳健性→政策沟通』的完整影响评估流程，方法範式与操作要点以世界银行官方方法手册 Khandker/Koolwal/Samad (2010) 为规范。
source_reference: PRIMARY: Khandker, S.R., Koolwal, G.B., Samad, H. (2010)《Handbook on Impact Evaluation: Quantitative Methods and Practices》World Bank, DOI 10.1596/978-0-8213-8028-4 → https://openknowledge.worldbank.org/handle/10986/2693。章5 Double Difference（pp.71-84）核实的原文：DD 估计式 (5.1) 'DD = E(Y1T - Y0T | T1 = 1) - E(Y1C - Y0C | T1 = 0)'；'Unlike PSM alone, the DD estimator allows for unobserved heterogeneity ... that may lead to selection bias. ... DD assumes this unobserved heterogeneity is time invariant, so the bias cancels out through differencing. In other words, the outcome changes for nonparticipants reveal the counterfactual outcome changes...'；识别条件三条（p.73）：'The model in equation (outcome) is correctly specified... The error term is uncorrelated with the other variables in the equation: Cov(εit, Ti1)=0, Cov(εit, t)=0, Cov(εit, Ti1t)=0. The last of these assumptions, also known as the parallel-trend assumption, is the most critical. It means that unobserved characteristics affecting program participation do not vary over time with treatment status.'；'DD can be used on repeated cross-section data as well, as long as the composition of participant and control groups is fairly stable over time.'；圖5.2 Time-Varying Unobserved Heterogeneity（DD 高估/低估偏误）；面板固定效应模型 Yit=αTit+Xitβ+μi+εit；章2 讲 M&E 框架、基线与反事实设定；章3 溢出案例 'Selecting the Level of Randomization to Account for Spillovers'；章5 印尼铁剂项目基線+DID 案例（Thomas et al. 2004，含 placebo）；章10 各方法优劣比较与政策使用；附录 'Programs and .do Files for Chapter 12-16 Exercises'（Stata）。SUPPORTING: Gertler, Martinez, Premand, Rawlings & Vermeersch (2016)《Impact Evaluation in Practice》, Second Edition, World Bank, DOI 10.1596/978-1-4648-0779-4 → https://openknowledge.worldbank.org/handle/10986/25030 —— 四部分（评估什么与为什么/主要影响评估方法/评估管理/数据、影响分析与成果呈现，含研究伦理与伙伴关系专章）。
expert_raw_materials: ①项目文件：干预描述、rollout 规則与时间表、目标区域与合格标准、实施机构信息；②处理组与对照组的基線+追踪面板数据或重复截面（个体/家户/区域级，含变量代码簿与抽样权重）；③委托人撰写的变革理论初稿与政策问题（结果指标、期望效应量）；④若用行政数据：所有权人的访问授权文件。
usage_permissions: 方法层：手冊经世界银行开放知识库（OKR）免费全文下载，引用方法与按其执行不受限；作品级许可条款（OKR 通常 CC BY 3.0 IGO）未在本页面逐条核对——见 pending。数据层：使用世界银行 Microdata Library 的国家调查微数据需注册并按使用条款/DUA 执行、再分发另需许可（条款未逐条确认——见 pending）；本候选仅以方法手冊为规范，不附带 WB 原始微数据。
task_input: 项目文件集 + 面板/重复截面数据 + 抽样权重与代码簿 + 变革理论与结果指标规格 + 政策前/后时间窗界定
professional_operations: ①建立变革理论与结果指标体系（手冊章2 的 M&E 框架与基線设计）；②对照 RCT/匹配/IV/RD 的适用条件与方法优劣表选择 DID（章2 反事实逻辑、章10 方法比较）；③确认数据形态：面板或『组成保持稳定』的重复截面（章5 原句），界定处理/对照 × 前/后四群组；④指定模型 DD=E(Y1T−Y0T|T1=1)−E(Y1C−Y0C|T1=0)，多期扩展为面板固定效应模型 Yit=αTit+Xitβ+μi+εit（章5）；⑤逐条检验识别假设并点名：平行趋势（p.73 三条件之三，含 Cov(εit,Ti1t)=0；绘趋势图+前趋势检验）——即 DID 语境的 'unconfoundedness' 形态；时不变未观测异质性（章5 原句）；无同期混淆冲击；组组成稳定；SUTVA/无溢出（章3 溢出案例的反面教材）；⑥估计 DID 系数，按处理单元层级聚类计算稳健标准误与置信区间；若数据来自复杂抽样调查，另按抽样权重与整群/分层设计做加权方差估计，并分列加权/未加权口径；⑦稳健性：安慰剂结果/基線平衡、延滞效应与机制辅证（章5 印尼铁剂项目案例范式）；⑧撰写含假设声明、局限与政策建议的影响评估报告并向委託方沟通。
expected_deliverable: 影响评估报告/政策备忘录：变革理论与指标图、基线与平行趋势图、DID 估计表（系数+聚类SE+CI+样本量）、识别假设逐条判断表（含加权/未加权口径）、稳健性检验、局限与政策結論
success_criteria: ①基線期前趋势检验不拒绝平行趋势（无系统斜差且事后检验标注）；②估计表含四群组均值、DID 系数、聚类 SE 与 90/95% CI，可独立復算；③识别假设逐条有数据或设计论据支持的书面判断；④政策結論与系数大小、置信区间一致，统计不显著时如实表述；⑤方法节点名全部关键假设。
verification_approach: Linux 上用 Python（linearmodels/statsmodels）或 R（fixest/did）独立复现：①构造已知真实效应的模拟面板（含平行趋势成立与违反两情境）验证估计器还原与趋势检验检验力/误判；②真实数据做事件研究（event study）与安慰剂期检验并绘趋势图；③与手冊附录 Stata 练习逻辑对照（.do 檔在附录，本批未运行）。假设：识别假设成立（方可在其下解释为因果效应）；聚類层級指定正确（通常处理单元层級——标准做法）；两期或平衡面板/重复截面满足章5 条件。
platform_dependencies: Linux + Python3 或 R（开源栈原生支持）；官方範例为 Stata（手冊附录 .do 档），Linux 需 Stata 商用许可证或等价移植实现（构成部分功能替代）；数据访问需机构 DUA/注册渠道；无 GPU 等专用硬件需求。
blocking_risks: ①无基線数据时平行趋势不可检验，影响评估退化为更弱主张；②同期其他政策/冲击混淆处理效应；③处理单元数量少时聚类推断失效（如省份级别试点）；④重复截面下组组成漂移破坏可比性（章5 所述）；⑤数据授权/DUA 延迟导致项目停顿。

workflow_title: AEA 复制包（Replication Package）合规核查与复现验证工作流
occupation_scope: 经济学期刊数据编辑办公室复现专员（replicator/data editor staff）执行期刊侧验证；反向支撑经济学作者复制包的准备与修订；产物为验证结论与复现报告（replication report）
workflow_summary: 以美国经济学会（AEA）数据与代码可得性政策及官方指南为规范，对条件接收论文的复制包执行『合规要素核查→受限环境重执行全部代码→输出与论文图表逐一比对→问题清单/复现报告→修订与归档』的验证流程；同一规范反向定义作者侧『准备→自查清单→提交 DCA Form→回应复现报告』的合规工作链。
source_reference: PRIMARY: AEA Data and Code Availability Policy → https://www.aeaweb.org/journals/data/data-code-policy — 采纳 DCAS v1.0；要求 Data Availability Statement（DCAS #1）含数据来源、获取条件与成本，非公开数据说明原因；原文：'The AEA data editor will assess compliance with this policy, including by conducting reproducibility checks and verifying the accuracy of the information provided.'。SUPPORTING: ①AEA Data Editor 指南首页 https://aeadataeditor.github.io/aea-de-guidance/ —— 流程：prepare replication package → upload metadata & package → submit Data and Code Availability Form → verification checks begin → replication report；②Preparing your files for verification https://aeadataeditor.github.io/aea-de-guidance/preparing-for-data-deposit.html —— README 必需要素、数据引用、代码完整性（'your data and code deposit contains all code... including code to read in raw data, even when the data cannot be provided'）、final checklist（'your replication package has been re-executed...'）；③DCAS v1.0 https://datacodestandard.org/ —— 准则 #1 数据可得性声明、#4 开放格式、#6 数据引用、#7 数据转换程序、#8 分析程序、#11 伦理批准披露、#12 预注册、#13 README 含软硬件依赖与预期运行时长、#14 存于期刊认可仓库、#15 许可；④Data and Code Availability Form https://www.aeaweb.org/journals/forms/data-code-availability （本体为 PDF，HTTP 200 字节级验证；AcroForm 字段未能从字节抽取——见 pending）；⑤FAQ https://aeadataeditor.github.io/aea-de-guidance/FAQ.html —— 许可：'Most deposits are under a mixed CC-BY/BSD license, or under a CC-BY license. Both licenses allow for re-use and re-distribution, under acknowledgement (citation) of the DOI of the replication package.'；机密数据可仅向数据编辑提供用于复现而不公开；早期 AEA 网站存档版权归 AEA 但自动许可使用（须致谢）。
expert_raw_materials: ①论文的表与图（exhibits）编号对照；②作者复制包：原始数据或获取说明、数据转换代码、分析代码、图表生成代码、README（按官方模板）、LICENSE；③已填写的 Data and Code Availability Form；④（可选）作者环境的运行日志与版本清单。
usage_permissions: 政策页、指南页、FAQ 与 DCAS 为公开规范文档，引用无碍；复制包内数据按包内许可使用——openICPSR 存檔多为 CC-BY/BSD 混合或 CC-BY（FAQ 原句），再使用/再分发须按 DOI 致谢引用；早期 AEA 网站存档 'permission is automatically granted'（FAQ 原句，须致谢）；机密/受限数据仅用于复现核查、不挪作他用（FAQ 所述特殊处理）。openICPSR 站点对自动访问实测 403（见 pending）。
task_input: 复制包 + 论文 exhibits + Data and Code Availability Form + 可运行计算环境；执行者为期刊侧复现专员
professional_operations: ①按 Preparing-your-files-for-verification 文档核查包结构与 README 必需要素：数据来源与获取方式、计算要求、运行说明、预期输出与时长（DCAS #13）；②核查数据引用完整性与 Data Availability Statement 一致性（DCAS #6/#1），含代码完整性（'including code to read in raw data, even when the data cannot be provided'）；③在受限环境按 README 顺序重执行整套代码（raw data 读入→转换→分析→图表），采集每步退出码、运行时长、输出文件；④将输出与论文 exhibits 逐一比对（数值/图形 diff），形成逐表逐图的复现矩阵（成功/容差内偏差/失败+原因）；⑤核查许可、开放格式与披露要求（DCAS #4/#11 伦理批准/#12 预注册/#15 许可）；⑥出具复现报告：通过或问题清单+修正要求，回传作者修订；⑦归档通过验证的复制包并记录 DOI 引用。
expected_deliverable: 复现报告（逐表逐图复现状态+偏差说明+修正要求）+ 合规核查清单 + 通过验证的复制包最终存檔（README、LICENSE、数据可得性声明齐备）与 DOI 引用记录
success_criteria: ①论文全部图表均有复现判定（成功/容差内偏差/失败+原因）；②README 模板必需要素覆盖 100%（逐条勾稽）；③包内转换/分析/图表代码全部被执行且输出匹配；④验证终态以复现报告为客观载体，由数据编辑办公室决定接受或退回修订。
verification_approach: Linux 上用容器（Docker/Singularity）按包重建环境：①遵 README 顺序执行 make/脚本，采集退出码与输出哈希；②对 exhibits 做 diff：表格 CSV 数值比对、图形以像素/统计量比对；③按模板逐项核对 README 与 DCA Form 的一致性。假设：数据可得或合法获取路径有效（DCAS #1 例外声明的成立性）；计算环境可复原（开发者以显式版本/容器声明——DCAS #13 义务）；预期运行时长在可行范围。无法验证的环节（如仅保密数据）在报告中标记『无法验证』而非通过——按政策原文 'verifying the accuracy of the information provided' 的范围如实限定。
platform_dependencies: Linux + 容器（Docker/Singularity）+ 视包而定的统计环境（Stata/R/Python/Matlab/Julia；商业软件需许可证）+ 网络访问 aeaweb.org、datacodestandard.org、openICPSR 及包内数据源；大包（数 GB/数千文件）需足够磁盘与传输带宽。
blocking_risks: ①包内需商业软件（Stata/Matlab）而本地无许可证时部分代码不能原样执行（可等价重写+注明）；②保密/受限数据只能核代码、复现判定受限；③openICPSR 对自动访问设反爬（本代理实测 403），脚本化上传/下载受阻；④超长运行时间需分段/异步执行；⑤作者包缺 README 要素或数据引用时核查卡在合规层。
expert_capability: 复现专员/数据编辑助理：熟练多种统计软件与容器化、可复现工作流（Make、版本控制）、理解 AEA 政策与 DCAS 各条款、能从论文图表回溯到生成代码与数据、具备与作者沟通的审查素养与职业谨慎。
cross_domain_overlap: 本工作流是横切性的『复制包验证』专业工作流，方法可套用于任何实证领域，但其规范主体、存檔地点（AEA Data and Code Repository/openICPSR）与致谢义务由经济学共同体定义；与 6.7 量化金融（交易代码不进入期刊复现义务流）、6.3 企业内部决策、6.2 保险精算、B1 医学（治疗效应估计的监管复现语境）在输入（论文复制包 vs 市场数据/病歷/賠付数据）、操作（合规与复现核查 vs 交易/定價/治疗效应）与产物（复现报告 vs 收益/報表/临床結論）三层均不同。
granularity_check: 限定为 AEA 期刊复制包准备-验证-报告链；不做数据分析本身（属 soc_econ_wf01/wf02 的内容），不扩展到其他学科的通用复现规范。

privacy_considerations: 保密/受限数据仅核代码或按约定环境处理，不透传个体数据；公开包含个体层数据者须已脱敏并在 README 记录披露控制；审查过程不额外采集个人信息。
research_ethics: 复现审查者不挪用未公开数据；核实论文伦理批准与预注册披露（DCAS #11/#12）；对无法验证部分如实标记，不制造虚假『通过』；审查脚本与判定记录版本化可审计（对双方公平）。
reproducibility_assessment: 本工作流本身就是 AEA 以制度强制『可复现性检查』的官方实施机制（policy 页原文：'...by conducting reproducibility checks and verifying the accuracy of the information provided'）；其产物复现报告是标准化的复现评估载体；审查者自身的核查脚本亦应版本化、可被第三方审计（对审查的复现）——符合 AEA 政策对可复现性的双重义务。

workflow_title: 基于联合国指南的分层多阶段整群家户调查抽样设计工作流
occupation_scope: 国家统计机构抽样设计专家/调查统计师，服务官方家户调查项目（劳动力、收支、健康、贫困监测等），也服务于国际组织与研究机构的调查设计环节
workflow_summary: 为家户社会经济调查设计科学抽样方案：『目标/估计域界定→抽样框构建与覆盖评估→分层→多阶段整群与 PPS/PPES 抽选→样本量计算与分配（含设计效应 deff 与无响应调整）→加权重构（基础权重→无响应→校准）→抽样误差估计方案→设计文档』，以联合国统计司官方实务指南为完整规范。
source_reference: PRIMARY: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Statistics Division (2005)《Designing Household Survey Samples: Practical Guidelines》Studies in Methods, Series F No. 98, ST/ESA/STAT/SER.F/98, New York → https://unstats.un.org/unsd/demographic/sources/surveys/Handbook23June05.pdf （HTTP 200，全本 PDF 抽取核实；版权页 'Copyright © United Nations 2005 All rights reserved'）。前言自述目的：'to include in one publication the main sample survey design issues that can conveniently be referred to by practicing national [statisticians]'。章节（经文本抽取核实）：1.2 数据源评估（普查/行政记录/家户调查）；3.3 Sampling strategies（3.3.5 Clustering effects —— deff/deft 定义为复杂设计方差与 SRS 方差之比；3.3.6 Adjusting sample size for anticipated non-response；3.3.10 Sample size calculation）；3.4 Stratification（含 3.4.3 Implicit stratification）；3.5 Cluster sampling；3.7 PPS sampling（3.7.1）与 PPES（3.7.2）；3.8 方案选项（Epsem/PPS/fixed）；5.4 Response rates and coverage rates；5.5 Weighting（'base weights, non-response and other adjustments'）；并载复制权重可反映无响应调整、复制法计算密集、抽样误差估计应针对关键估计量、Stata 支持分层多阶段方差估计等要点。SUPPORTING: 手册引用体系（联合国家户调查能力项目出版物、人口与住房普查建议 ST/ESA/STAT/SER.M/67/Rev.1 等）作为抽样框相关规范的延伸引用。
expert_raw_materials: ①抽样框材料：最近人口普查/行政登记的分层单元（行政区-普查区-村/街区）人口与住户数、边界/地图与 enumeration area 划分；②上轮同主题调查数据（估 deff/设计效应、无响应率与域间变异）；③调查问卷草稿与关键变量清单（定域与精度基础）；④委托方精度/预算/时限说明书。
usage_permissions: 手册为联合国出版物（版权页 'Copyright © United Nations 2005 All rights reserved'）：为研究引用其方法与少量摘引属允许的引用使用；全文翻印/商业性重制需向 UN Publications 申请（条款未逐条核对——见 pending）。抽样框与普查/行政数据服从各国统计法与机构授权，本候选不主张任何默认豁免。
task_input: 抽样框表+地图、上轮调查数据、问卷草稿、精度与估计域需求说明书
professional_operations: ①界定调查目标、目标总体、估计域（domains）与关键指标的精度/置信度要求；②评估数据源与抽样框（手册 1.2：普查/行政记录/新列表），核查覆盖与更新（含 area sampling 概念）；③按 3.4 设计分层（显式+隐式分层的规则与跨层分配），3.5 确定整群与第一阶段抽样单元（PSU）；④第一阶段按 PPS（度量=人口/住户规模测度）或 PPES 抽选 PSU（3.7.1/3.7.2），后续阶段按系统抽样抽取次级/最终单元，方案选项（Epsem/PPS/固定等）按 3.8 与精度-成本权衡确定；⑤按 3.3.10 计算样本量：关键估计式 × 设计效应（deff/deft，3.3.5）→ 按预期无响应率上调（3.3.6）→ 按域内需求分配；⑥构建加权重构方案：基础权重（选择概率倒数）→ 无响应调整 → 其他校准（5.5：'base weights, non-response and other adjustments'），每阶段记录选择概率；⑦制定抽样误差估计方案（复杂方差/复制权重/Taylor 线性化；复制权重须注入无响应调整——手册要点），抽样误差估计针对关键估计量展开（手册要点）；⑧撰写抽样设计文档：覆盖评估、每阶段概率、权重推导、误差估计与局限，供实施团队与第三方复算。
expected_deliverable: 抽样设计技术文档：分层与域规格、每阶段选择概率与抽选步骤（含随机种子）、样本量表（关键指标 SE/CV、deff、无响应假设）、权重计算规则、方差估计方案、质量保证清单（覆盖率/无响应跟踪点）
success_criteria: ①关键指标的设计 SE/CV 达委托方精度要求且可由方案独立复算；②每阶段选择概率可追溯、抽选可重现（固定种子）；③权重和≈目标总体规模、权重构成逻辑自洽（基础→无响应→校准可拆解）；④第三方按文档能重放抽选并复算样本量与权重（文档自足性检验）；⑤无响应与覆盖测量点在方案中明示阈值。
verification_approach: Linux 上用 Python/R 复算：①按设计文档的分层与 PPS 步骤重放抽选（固定种子）并比对抽中单元集；②用公式重算样本量/deff 并与手册算例口径对照；③断言：选择概率归一化、权重和与总体规模一致、复制方差与线性化结果同阶。假设：抽样框记录完整且规模测度（MOS）为最近普查/登记数据的近似真值；deff 与无响应率等先验取自上轮同主题调查（手册的常规做法）；委托方对精度/成本的约束在设计空间内可行（否则进入协商，不属本工作流的失败）。
platform_dependencies: Linux + Python3（numpy/pandas；专用抽样库如 samplics 或 R 'sampling'/'survey' 包——本机未实测安装，见 pending）；抽样框表通常为 CSV/XLSX 原生可读；GIS 边界可用开源 QGIS 核查覆盖；无专有许可依赖；手册 PDF 直接可读。实地的列册/测绘（field listing/mapping）环节必须由现场团队执行，不在 Agent 自动化范围内（工作流按此法限定并在文档中声明）。
blocking_risks: ①抽样框过期或行政区划变更导致覆盖偏倚（手册 1.2/5.4 的覆盖评估正为此设）；②无上轮数据时 deff/无响应先验缺失，需保守假设并明示；③层级与域增多时精度-预算-时限约束不可同时满足；④实地列册/测绘不能由 Agent 替代，委托方须有现场能力；⑤委托方对『代表性』的期望超出预算可行集（需在前两阶段写入文档声明）。
expert_capability: 抽样统计师：掌握分层多阶段整群设计理论（PPS/PPES、deff/组内相关）与实现、加权重构与无响应调整、抽样误差估计（复制与线性化）、能把设计落地为可执行的抽选算法与自足文档（官方统计机构培养路径）。
cross_domain_overlap: 抽样方法本身是横切性方法，但本候选的输入（普查/行政抽样框+上轮家户调查）、操作（分层多阶段、PPS、deff 样本量、权重重构）与产物（抽样设计文档）属官方家户统计生产语境；与 6.2 精算抽样（为理赔/风险定价服务的业务抽样）、6.3 企业调查抽样（服务于内部经营 KPI）应用语境不同；与本批 soc_econ_wf01 互补（wf04 做『设计』、wf01 用既有公开微数据做『误差估计』），不构成重复；与 B1 临床试验样本量计算（伦理、随机分组、监管语境）分属不同专业规范。
granularity_check: 收敛到『抽样方案设计+权重与误差估计方案+文档』环节；不含现场执行与数据收集管理（另成工作流的空间，非本行内容）。
pending_confirmation: ①手册为 2005 年版，UNSD 是否有更新替代版本未检索确认（E1 引用的规范时效为 2005）；②PDF 抽取文本存在分词伪影（如 'Sa m p ling'），英文引用句按抽取文本扁平化校读，未经印刷版逐字比对；③UN Publications 翻印/重制许可条款未逐条核对；④开源抽样库（samplics/R sampling）本机未实际安装验证（本批不执行代码的约定）；⑤手册提到的统计软件（STATA 等）现状未逐一核对。
data_usage_authorization: 手册按联合国版权仅作引用与遵循使用；抽样框/普查与行政数据依各国统计法及机构授权文件（DUA/MOU）使用，本候选不主张默认豁免；问卷工具的知识产权归设计机构。
privacy_considerations: 设计阶段一般不接触个体登记；若抽样框含住户级清单则按数据保护要求加密存储、最小化使用、依统计法保密；发布细粒度域估计时遵守披露控制与小单元门槛。
research_ethics: 通过分层/域设计保障脆弱群体在设计中的可代表性；调查实施环节要求知情同意与数据用途告知（设计文档写入实施要求）；抽样偏差如实陈述（覆盖偏差、无响应偏差均在设计文档披露，不宣称无偏）；未加权口径的统计推断须注明并限制解释（加/未加权明示）。
reproducibility_assessment: 抽选算法+种子+设计文档使选择与权重可被独立复算；若调查数据用于学术发表，按 AEA data and code availability policy（https://www.aeaweb.org/journals/data/data-code-policy）提供数据可得性声明；抽样设计与权重建构脚本属分析程序（DCAS #7/#8 语义）应入复制包。
primary_claim: 联合国统计司官方手册（Series F No. 98, © UN 2005）在单一权威来源中完整记载家户调查抽样的全部核心环节——数据源评估、分层（含隐式）、多阶段整群、PPS/PPES、样本量（deff/无响应调整）、加权重构与抽样误差估计——构成该工作流的 E1 级规范；前言自述即面向执业国家统计师的实务指引。
